posts.text: U.S. Military Strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island in What U.S. Officials Call a Defensive Measure — The action was limited, the officials said, with no immediate plans to escalate. The strikes come on the eve of the midterm elections.
Yemen gov’t accuses IRGC, Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to back Houthis — Yemeni interior minister says foreign involvement expanded beyond arms and training to directing military operations.

Israeli Claims of Iranian Chemical Weapons Divide U.S. Officials — Some administration officials suggested Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is trying to draw President Trump back into military action.

Iran Says It Would Reopen Strait of Hormuz in 2 Days as Part of U.S. Deal — Iranian officials spoke of some progress in negotiating to reopen the strait even as they prepared for all-out war. A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Monday to meet with the foreign minister to continue talks.
BREAKING: TRUMP BOMBS IRAN RIGHT BEFORE MIDTERMS!! VOTING MACHINES DOWN IN NY COUNTY!! — Support The Show On Patreon!:
Why Trump Often Mentioned Iran in the Midterm Campaign — President Trump has repeatedly reminded Americans of a losing campaign issue just as voters head to the polls. Why?

What the midterm elections could mean for markets, debt — Democrats winning Congress could mean tougher AI oversight and market volatility, while a Republican sweep may ease concerns over tech investigations.

As Trump’s Midterm Deadline Looms, Gulf Countries Brace for Possible Renewal of Iran War — The energy-rich Gulf Arab countries are engaged in a flurry of mediation efforts to avert war between the U.S. and Iran, as many fear that the fighting will be worse this time around.

U.S. launches new attacks on Iranian targets days after Netanyahu pressed Trump for more strikes — Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pushed for another wave of strikes on Iran after the U.S. elections, according to two regional officials and a third person familiar with the matter.

Indian navy rescues 20 crew from Iranian fishing boat hijacked off Somalia — he operation involved a warship, a maritime surveillance aircraft and marine commandos. The hijacking followed a resurgence of Somali piracy across the Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean.

Affordability takes center stage as Americans cast their ballots in high-stakes midterms — High prices for gasoline and other goods are key issues for midterm voters, with six in 10 Americans citing the cost of living as their chief concern.

The battle for Congress is just the beginning. Here's what's at stake on Election Day — Election Day 2026 sees Republicans defending slim majorities as early voting shatters records with over 54 million ballots already cast nationwide.
